services.name: Welding Classes
services.desc: Ready to channel your inner blacksmith? Thrill seekers and fans of Forged in Fire will love taking a blacksmithing class at our workshop in Brooklyn! The ancient art of blacksmithing is one of the oldest trades in human history, dating back over 3,000 years. Before working with iron, people used bronze to create tools, weapons, and ornaments as far back as 1200 BCE. Today, the craft of blacksmithing has found new life in artistic and decorative metalworking and is practiced as both an art form and a niche trade. Whether you’re a crafting enthusiast or you’re just the type who likes playing with fire, Craftsman Ave offers beginner-friendly and intermediate blacksmithing workshops in Brooklyn

services.desc: Looking for an unforgettable way to celebrate a birthday? Craftsman Ave offers a unique and exciting alternative to the usual birthday party. Our DIY Workshops are perfect for bringing friends and family together to create something amazing while celebrating a special day. Our birthday party workshops are beginner-friendly and guided by our skilled instructors who will assist you every step of the way. With a wide variety of projects to choose from, you and your guests can dive into crafting with wood, metal, leather, glass, or even try your hand at knife making. After the tools are set aside, you can enjoy your own birthday treats and refreshments in our cozy lounge or at a private table.
